description: A list item sits directly in a div, with no list around it.

issue.help: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
issue.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  List item does not have a <ul> or <ol> parent element. Ensure the <li> is a direct child of a <ul> or <ol>, or that the parent has role="list".
